about.title: About Me
about.description:
Hi, I'm Farhan Shaikh 👋
Life Sciences Student | Digital Creator | Storyteller

Who I Am

I am a Life Sciences student at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU), Hyderabad. I enjoy learning about life sciences while also exploring digital creativity, technology, video editing, AI content creation, and storytelling.

What I Do

🔬 Life Sciences & Learning
I enjoy understanding biological concepts, practical learning, and continuously expanding my knowledge.

🎬 Digital Creativity
I create videos, edit content, explore AI tools, and experiment with new creative ideas.

💻 Technology & Content
I enjoy exploring modern technology, digital media, social platforms, and new ways to turn ideas into engaging content.

My Philosophy

Learn. Create. Improve. Repeat.

I believe curiosity, consistency, and creativity are the foundation of personal growth.

Let's Connect

I'm always open to learning, creating, collaborating, and exploring new ideas.
